hero.headline: Temporary Voice Channels
hero.description: Give your users total control. Think of it as a voice channel that only exists when someone actually needs it. When a user joins a <highlight>Join to Create</highlight> channel, Horizon spins up a private room. Once everyone leaves, it's gone.

features.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to manage voice channels with ease. What is free, will be free. Forever.

items.title: Instant Voice Channels
items.description: The moment a user joins a Join to Create channel, Horizon spins up a private room in milliseconds. No waiting, no manual setup required.

items.title: Automatic Cleanup
items.description: Once everyone leaves, the channel is automatically deleted. No leftovers, no clutter. Your channel list stays clean without any intervention.

items.title: Zero Configuration
items.description: Set up a single <highlight>Join to Create</highlight> channel and Horizon handles the rest. No complicated configs, no permission headaches. It just works.

items.title: Your room, your rules.
items.description: Rename it, lock it, kick people out. The [panel](https://docs.horizon-bot.me/panel) puts everything in your hands. Prefer [slash commands](https://docs.horizon-bot.me/control-channel)? Those work too.

items.title: Configure it once, forget it.
items.description: Set default permissions, control who can rename or kick, restrict access to mods only. Everything is per-generator, so different channels can have different rules. [Easy setup with /setup](https://docs.horizon-bot.me/quickstart).

items.title: Save your setup, reuse it anytime.
items.description: Got a go-to channel setup? [Save it to a slot](https://docs.horizon-bot.me/session) and load it back whenever you need it. Up to three profiles per user, ready when you are.

items.title: You don't have to do it alone.
items.description: Promote up to seven trusted members to [channel moderators](https://docs.horizon-bot.me/mod) right from Discord. They can kick, block, manage the trusted list, and invite. They never take ownership, and all assignments clear automatically when the channel closes.

items.title: Know what's going on, instantly.
items.description: Horizon posts short [activity logs](https://docs.horizon-bot.me/features#in-channel-log-for-members) right inside your channel. Joined, left, claimed, transferred. Everyone in the room sees exactly what's happening, no external bot needed. Server admins can configure which events to track.

items.title: Still not convinced?
items.description: There's plenty more under the hood. Take a look at our [full documentation](https://docs.horizon-bot.me/) for everything Horizon can do.
